interface.signature: def findKthNumber(n: int, k: int) -> int

preconditions.description: k and n are integers within the range 1 to 10^9, and k is less than or equal to n.

postconditions.description: The returned value is an integer within the range 1 to n.
The returned value is the k-th smallest integer in the lexicographical order of numbers from 1 to n.
